title: Per-unit model probe (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlay for the 3D phase M2 per-unit models: the vanilla Rat gains `graphics { model { file "models/unit-box.gltf" ... } }` (a magenta 0.6-tile glTF box), so mewframework draws the box on every Rat and moves it with the Rat. Load it with fw-3d (the mesh shader and the Crate's crate.obj) and _autoplay (the fight plays itself, so the Rat walks): `mods: _unitmodel, fw-3d, _autoplay`. Never for play.
